sections.detail: Break 1: Stripped neurofunk, precise rhythmic rap

sections.detail: Final Chorus: Snap to 176 BPM neurofunk-rock, higher harmony, reed counter-melody

sections.detail: Outro: 88 BPM Rhodes, fully sung, restrained

telemetry.lyric: I only came in for a shelf
Now the kitchens have no end
Nine forty-five with a pencil and a trolley
Picked a little shelf and the building tried to swallow me
Yellow on the floor says keep to the route
Shortcut through the curtains puts the entrance further out
Heard a click in the ceiling
Now my badge says permanent assistant to the shelving
Found a little thread on the cuff of my coat
Tied it to a bed with a decorative throw
All this yellow leads me through
Ariadne, get me out of the showroom
I have seen enough of how a life could look
I want the crooked chair in my own room
I do not need a better world
I only came in for a shelf
Bull-headed floor cleaner guarding the throws
Red little sensor where the hot breath goes
Polishes a warning round the toes of my feet
Kitchen number seven has a loaf made of stone
Phone on the counter has no dialling tone
Every little drawer has a reason to exist
Mine has loose string and a key that never fits
Then a third with my measurements
Now the wardrobe doors are quietly explaining
I have got amug that works yet
If it has a window with an actual view
Ariadne, get me out of the showroom
I have seen enough of how a life could look
I want the crooked chair in my own room
I do not need a better world
I only came in for a shelf
